deploy.command: set -e; command -v wrangler >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'Cloudflare Wrangler is not installed'; exit 127; }; [[ -n "${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:-}" && -n "${CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID:-}" ]] || { echo 'Cloudflare credentials are not configured'; exit 126; }; [[ -f ./app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ]] || { echo 'RMM APK missing; build must succeed before deployment'; exit 125; }; rm -rf ./cloudflare-worker; mkdir -p ./cloudflare-worker; cp -f ./app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ./cloudflare-worker/RSS-Money-Manager.apk; sha256sum ./cloudflare-worker/RSS-Money-Manager.apk > ./cloudflare-worker/RSS-Money-Manager.apk.sha256; printf '%s\n' 'name = "rss-money-manager"' 'compatibility_date = "2026-10-05"' '[assets]' 'directory = "./cloudflare-worker"' > ./cloudflare-worker/wrangler.toml; wrangler deploy --config ./cloudflare-worker/wrangler.toml --name rss-money-manager --assets ./cloudflare-worker --compatibility-date 2026-10-05 --no-bundle
